passages.title: Results for You
passages.quote: Made medication more affordable We led Canada in expanding the use of biosimilar medications, which cost up to 50% less than the original drug. This is saving health care $732 million over 5 years, which is reinvested into BC PharmaCare to provide coverage for additional medications and medical devices, including continuous and flash glucose monitors for people with diabetes. Capped ferry fare increases We invested $500 million this year to cap ferry fare increases for the next four years.
